premises: Atomic-scale compositional heterogeneity exists in single-phase CoCrFeNi HEA nanopillars.
This heterogeneity creates spatial variations in stacking fault energy (SFE).
Local SFE variations cause synergistic activation of deformation twinning and dislocation slip.
Synergistic twinning and slip promote deformation delocalization and delay necking, enhancing ductility.
This mechanism explains high uniform elongation (~110%) at high flow stress (0.6–1.0 GPa).
